name: Alila Napa Valley
positioning: Adult-oriented wine country resort in St. Helena, next to Beringer's historic estate, with Yabu Pushelberg-designed rooms opening onto vineyard and mountain views
best_for: Couples on a Napa Valley wine country getaway
Travelers who want vineyard-view rooms with outdoor fireplaces
Guests interested in wine and wellness experiences

facts.text: The hotel is in Napa Valley wine country, steps from Beringer Vineyards and minutes from downtown St. Helena.
The hotel is set next to a historic estate winery, with views of Napa Valley vineyards and mountains.
The main building is a Georgian Revival-style mansion dating to 1905 that houses four guest rooms and the two restaurants.
Rooms have bespoke Italian furnishings, luxury linens and spa-inspired bathrooms with rain showers and soaking tubs.
Streamside Suites have a balcony over York Creek with an outdoor dining set, a firepit and a soaking tub.
Historic Manor rooms are in a restored manor house with town or vineyard views.
Spa Alila treatments use herbal remedies, basalt stones from the California coastline, obsidian gua sha stones and local handcrafted products.
Wellness experiences include forest bathing, astrology readings after dark, new moon yoga and vineyard-view painting.
Guests can create a custom room and aura mist with an expert perfumer, using local botanicals.
A tasting of historic cabernet sauvignon vintages can be hosted at the Rhine House or in a guest suite.
Reserved poolside cabanas include dining service, a lounging sofa and a private minifridge.
Violetto, the hotel restaurant, blends French culinary techniques with Italian flavors, with a prix fixe menu featuring handmade pasta.

highlights.text: Rooms and suites have oversize balconies or wraparound terraces with outdoor fireplaces.
Beringer Winery is reached via the resort's own footbridge, the Bridge to Beringer.
Rooms and suites were designed by Yabu Pushelberg.
Pedal and Pour is a guided bike ride through the vineyards of the St. Helena and Calistoga AVAs with Olabisi Wines founder Ted Osborne.
The heated outdoor pool is set against the Mayacamas Mountains.

considerations.text: The resort is tailored to adult guests, and rooms are limited to two guests each, including minors.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
